verdict.rationale: A sandbox or test environment is a fair question for an API-driven compliance screening SaaS, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a sandbox, test mode or non-production environment. The Postman collection, OpenAPI schema, API credentials and multiple screening configurations are adjacent developer aids, not an isolated environment separate from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
